{
  "project": "hive-research-gpu",
  "what_building": "A research paper summarization and surrogate generation service that processes academic documents, specifically focusing on multi-agent systems and reinforcement learning. It utilizes a pipeline to extract sections and generate summaries or 'surrogates' from paper abstracts and experimental details.",
  "pipeline": [
    "extract_sections",
    "summarize_section",
    "summarize_figures",
    "build_surrogate"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "paper_title",
    "abstract",
    "experimental setup",
    "figures available",
    "knowledge graph"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "section-wise summaries",
    "surrogates",
    "briefs"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.95,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "heuristic guess: paper-surrogate / research-paper summarizer :: paper sections (abstract/figures/experiments) -> section-wise summarization prompts -> surrogates/summaries",
    "heuristic pipeline: extract_sections -> summarize_section(model) -> summarize_figures -> build_surrogate",
    "schema hints: ['abstract', 'brief', 'experimental setup', 'figures available', 'knowledge graph', 'research questions']",
    "Title: {{paper_title}} ## abstract AOAD-MAT: Transformer-based Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Model"
  ]
}
